source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The Small School in the Valley
tts_text: Elena taught English in a small school in a valley, and she was fluent in three languages. Her mother had been a teacher too, and Elena inherited the school, part of the village heritage. By local convention, every family sent a child to her evening class. The classroom was compact, and when snow slid off the roof, the impact shook the wall. Good firewood was scarce that winter, and English books were rare in the village. Her influence on those children could not be measured. In the winter of that year, influenza came to the valley. A doctor from the city exerted all his strength, but the clinic had few supplies. Elena's family was not affluent, yet she never asked for money. For two weeks the mood in the classroom was tense. She kept up an intensive reading programme, and the work was intense. A good teacher needs a sense of what a child really needs. She was sensitive to every small change in their faces. Her commonsense told her to slow down, and her sensible plan was ten pages a day. Some parents called her method nonsense, but the children improved. In spring the snow melted, and a warm wind came over the fields. Elena even tamed a small wild bird that lived near the window. The sun is the source of light, and time is her most precious resource. She often spoke about mental health and about the fundamental rule of her school. A mistake in grammar is never fatal, she said. In total, forty pupils passed the exam that June. Now she keeps every record in digital form. Her greatest talent, the villagers said, was patience.

sentences_cn: 埃琳娜在山谷里一所小学校教英语，她能流利地说三种语言。
她母亲也曾是老师，埃琳娜继承了这所学校，它也是村里遗产的一部分。
按当地习俗，每家都送一个孩子来上她的夜课。
教室很紧凑，雪从屋顶滑下来时，那一下撞击震得墙壁直响。
那年冬天好柴火很缺，村里英语书也很少见。
她对那些孩子的影响无法估量。
那年冬天，流感来到了山谷。
城里来的医生用尽全身力气，但诊所的物资少得可怜。
埃琳娜家并不富裕，但她从不向人要钱。
有两个星期，教室里的气氛很紧张。
她坚持高强度的阅读计划，对每个人来说功课都很紧张。
好老师需要对孩子的真实需要有感觉。
她对孩子们脸上的每一点细小变化都很敏感。
她的常识告诉她该放慢节奏，于是她明智的计划变成了一天只读十页。
有些家长说她这套是胡说八道，但孩子们进步了。
春天雪化了，一阵暖风从田野上吹来。
埃琳娜甚至驯服了一只住在窗边的小野鸟。
太阳是光的来源，而时间是她最宝贵的资源。
她常谈起心理健康，也常谈起她学校的根本原则。
她说，语法上的错误从来都不致命。
那年六月，一共有四十名学生通过了考试。
现在她把所有记录都以数字形式保存。
村里人说，她最大的才能是耐心。
